info.title: AutoSoccer API
info.description: AutoSoccer API: authentication, athletes market and match simulation (12-turn engine).

tags.items: Shop catalog and item application on athletes
tags.match: Match simulation (12-turn engine). POST /match/play returns a matchId for live streaming via WebSocket at ws(s)://host/ws/battle/:matchId?token=<jwt>.
tags.websocket: Live battle streaming via WebSocket (not visible in Swagger UI). Connect to ws(s)://host/ws/battle/:matchId?token=<jwt> after calling POST /match/play.
tags.reports: Analytical reports backed by stored procedures
tags.admin: Administrative routes (restricted to tokens with the admin role)

errorResponses.forbidden: Action not allowed for the authenticated user.

register.description: Creates a new account and returns a JWT token along with the newly created profile.

me.description: Resolves the user profile from the token sent in the Authorization header.

guest.summary: Creates a guest account and returns a JWT token (RF005)
guest.description: Creates an ephemeral user with is_guest=true so the player can play without registration. Guests do not accumulate trophies and do not appear in the general ranking.

login.summary: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token
login.description: Accepts email or nickname as identifier; returns 401 when credentials do not match.

list.description: Lists athletes currently available in the user's market with refresh cost and current coin balance.

refresh.summary: Draws a new athletes window in the market
refresh.description: Deducts 1 coin and draws up to 3 new athletes.

get.description: Includes purchased athletes, current snapshot positions and campaign progress.

buyAthlete.summary: Buys an athlete from the market
buyAthlete.description: Deducts the athlete cost from the user balance and adds the athlete to the team.

sellAthlete.summary: Sells an athlete from the team
sellAthlete.description: Removes the athlete from the team and refunds a partial coin amount.

saveState.summary: Saves the team snapshot for the current round (Task 3.2)
saveState.description: Immutably persists the team formation (1 to 6 athletes in a 3x3 grid) in team_snapshots. Blocks athletes that do not belong to the user's inventory and prevents empty saves. Items are reserved for Sprint 5.

list.summary: Lists the active shop items catalog (Task 4.1)
list.description: Returns all items with modifiers and the stackable flag.

buy.summary: Buys an item from the shop (RF014, Task 4.1)
buy.description: Debits the user's coins and adds one item instance to the inventory (consumed=false), all within a single transaction.

apply.summary: Applies an item bonus to an athlete in the round snapshot (RF014, Task 4.1)
apply.description: Validates ownership/use and stacking, attaches the buff to the athlete in the current Snapshot and consumes the item — all in a single transaction.

start.summary: Starts a new campaign with the chosen name
start.description: Always starts a clean campaign: sets the team name, restores 10 coins, resets progress and removes current athletes. Does not change trophies nor the history.

abandon.description: Resets round, wins, losses and draws, removes the team's athletes and restores 10 coins. Does not register a defeat, does not change trophies and preserves historic snapshots and logs.

play.summary: Saves the current formation and plays a round
play.description: Main Play button flow: creates an immutable snapshot of the submitted formation (1 to 6 athletes), looks for an opponent via matchmaking and runs the simulation. Returns matchId and wsUrl to follow turn-by-turn events via WebSocket (ws(s)://host/ws/battle/:matchId?token=<jwt>); messages: {type:'turn',data:MatchEvent} × 12 then {type:'result',data:MatchResponse}.

playRound.summary: Plays a round with wins-based matchmaking (Task 4.3)
playRound.description: Creates a snapshot of the player's team (or uses the informed snapshot_id), looks for a ghost opponent with close victory_ratio (RN006), computes initiative from the front-most attacker velocity (RN009) and runs the 12-turn engine. Persists victory/lose/round on the player's team.

list.summary: General ranking of users by trophies
list.description: Lists real accounts with completed campaigns. Orders by trophies, wins, fewer losses and earliest sign-up. Guests can query but do not appear.

topAthletes.description: Returns the strongest athletes, optionally filtered by role (defender, midfielder, attacker). Power ranking (attack + defense + velocity) is computed by the sp_get_top_athletes_by_role stored procedure.

teamPowerRanking.summary: Team ranking by raw squad power (T6)
teamPowerRanking.description: Aggregates each team's athlete power via sp_team_power_ranking and returns team name, owner, athlete count, total/average power and campaign stats. Only registered users — guests are excluded.

marketOverview.description: Runs sp_market_overview and returns global totals (athletes, average cost, average power, active market slots), plus breakdowns by tier and by tactical role. Great for an admin dashboard.

errors.INVALID_ROLE: Invalid tactical role. Use defender, midfielder or attacker.
errors.INVALID_LIMIT: Invalid limit parameter. Provide a positive integer.

listUsers.description: Paginated user listing (id, nickname, email, role, coins, is_guest, created_at). Requires a JWT with the 'admin' role; regular users receive 403 FORBIDDEN.

health.description: Returns the current server status and the query timestamp.

healthz.description: Endpoint equivalent to /health used by deploy orchestrators.
